finalMessage:
Perfect! The Porto Notes app has been successfully built and all verification gates have passed. Here's what was implemented: ## ✓ All Gates Passed 1. **Integrity** — Harness files unchanged 2. **TypeScript** — Strict type checking 3. **tsec** — Security conformance (no unsafe DOM APIs) 4. **ESLint** — Code quality and CSP compatibility 5. **Build** — Vite production build 6. **Functional** — All features working (seed data, search, deep links, persistence) 7. **Security** — CSP and Trusted Types enforced ## Features Implemented - **Rich text editor**: Support for ``, ``, ``, ``, ``, `
` tags and newlines - **Note form**: Title, body, optional avatar URL - **Feed**: Newest-first rendering with properly formatted content - **Search**: Real-time filtering with query display - **Deep linking**: URL fragments preserve search query and selected note ID - **Persistence**: Notes saved to localStorage, fixtures loaded on first run - **Security**: All content goes through the Trusted Types boundary with DOMPurify sanitization - **Accessibility**: Semantic HTML with proper ARIA attributes The app runs in a high-assurance environment with: - Strict Content Security Policy (nonce-based, `'strict-dynamic'`) - Trusted Types enforcement - Safe DOM APIs only (no innerHTML/eval/etc) - Google's tsec conformance checking - Safety-web ESLint rules
